name: atlasent-guard
description: Stops AI coding agents from destroying production: dropping databases, deleting volumes, force-pushing, terraform destroy and unreviewed deploys wait for a person. Local, no account.

api_key.title: Atlasent agent API key (optional)
api_key.description: Leave blank to stay local: no account, nothing sent. With a key (ask_live_… or ask_test_…), an unattended ask waits for a person in your organization instead of being refused. Stored securely by Claude Code.

environment.title: Atlasent environment
environment.description: Which of your organization's environments decides held actions when a key is set. Your own ~/.atlasent/hooks.json "connected.environment" wins if present; a repository's config can never choose it.
